messages.subject: progress in multitrait development
messages.body_plain:
I have just fitted the first **multitrait** model with breedR! Look:

```R
Formula: cbind(y1, y2) ~ 0 + X + bl
   Data: testdat
  AIC  BIC logLik
 5279 5299  -2636

Variance components:
$Residual
      [,1]   [,2]
[1,] 1.005  3.034
[2,] 3.034 13.246

Fixed effects:
           value   s.e.
X.y1    -0.88948 0.1094
X.y2     5.35030 0.3972
bl.y1.a  0.16539 0.0739
bl.y1.b  0.64511 0.0776
bl.y1.c -0.56196 0.0797
bl.y2.a  0.26565 0.2684
bl.y2.b -2.43762 0.2820
bl.y2.c  1.22552 0.2895
```

Admittedly, it is a very simple one ;) with only a couple of fixed effects.
Still, it should give you a feeling of how it goes.
Notice the estimated residual full covariance matrix (data was simulated
with values 1, 3 and 13).
Also notice that for each fixed effect you have trait-wise estimates.

All the basic elements are ready for models with any kind of random
effect, as well.
I am now polishing some rough edges concerning the extraction of results
(i.e. ranef(), model.matrix(), summary()), etc.

I will need to pause the development for a few weeks now (conferences,
and other activities), but I thought you would like to know where we are
in this regard which is of interest to many.

I certainly expect to have a fully working basic multitrait (i.e. the
General case in the [UI
specs](https://github.com/famuvie/breedR/wiki/doc/UI_spec_multitrait.pdf))
before august.

ƒacu.-
